name: @w6w-apps/systemeio
description: Manage contacts, tags, funnels, email campaigns and newsletters, courses and communities, and webhooks on systeme.io.

w6w.longDescription:
systeme.io manages contacts, tags, funnels, email campaigns and newsletters, courses and enrollments, communities and memberships, and outbound webhooks — the full breadth of systeme.io's all-in-one marketing platform, at the granularity its public API actually exposes. Contacts can be created, tagged and updated; funnels, campaigns and newsletters can be created, read and updated; course enrollments and community memberships can be managed; and webhooks can be registered so a workflow reacts to systeme.io's own events rather than polling for them.

Partial updates use systeme.io's own merge-patch format so an update only touches the fields actually sent, and pagination follows systeme.io's own cursor convention, always keyed off the last item returned rather than a page number. Because systeme.io publishes no account or profile endpoint, connection health is checked against a harmless list of custom field definitions rather than a page of real contact data.

Authoring the actual content inside a funnel or campaign — individual pages and emails — is left to systeme.io's own visual editor, and billing surfaces like coupons, price plans and subscriptions sit outside this app's marketing-automation focus.
